```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)

#Load in data
Solar_ATB <- read.csv("Processed_Data/Solar_ATB_Long.csv")

view(Solar_ATB)
Solar_ATB <- Solar_ATB %>%
  select(-"X")

view(Solar_ATB)

```


```{r}
library(lme4)
library(nlme)

Solar_ATB

multi_model1 <- lme(LCOE ~ Annual_Generation_MWh + Technology,
                   random = ~1 | Class, data = Solar_ATB)

summary(multi_model1)
plot(multi_model1)

AIC(multi_model1)
```

```{r}
gen1.lm <- lm(LCOE ~
                Class + Technology +
                Annual_Generation_MWh,
             data = Solar_ATB)
```



```{r}
plot(gen1.lm)

```

```{r}

Solar_ATB_log <- Solar_ATB %>% 
  mutate(Annual_Energy_Production_log =
           log10(Annual_Energy_Production))

gen2.lm <- lm(LCOE ~
                Class + Technology +
                Annual_Energy_Production_log,
             data = Solar_ATB_log)

gen3.lm <- lm(LCOE ~
                Annual_Energy_Production + CAPEX,
             data = Solar_ATB)

gen4.lm <- lm(LCOE ~
                Annual_Energy_Production_log + Construct_Finance_Costs,
             data = Solar_ATB_log)


```


```{r}

plot(gen2.lm)
plot(gen3.lm)
plot(gen4.lm)

```

# Testing Net Capacity

```{r}
net1.lm <- lm(LCOE ~
                Net_Cap_Factor + Technology,
             data = Solar_ATB_log)

Solar_ATB_log <- Solar_ATB %>% 
  mutate(Net_Cap_Factor_log =
           log10(Net_Cap_Factor))

net2.lm <- lm(LCOE ~
                Net_Cap_Factor_log + Technology,
             data = Solar_ATB_log)

class.lm <- lm(LCOE ~
                Class + Technology,
             data = Solar_ATB_log)

plot(net1.lm)
plot(net2.lm)
plot(class.lm)

```

```{r}



summary(multi_model1)

multi_model2 <- lme(LCOE ~ Net_Cap_Factor +
                      Annual_Energy_Production + Technology,
                   random = ~1 | Class, data = Solar_ATB)

summary(multi_model2)

```
